name: Convex

prompts.text: Start a new Convex app for a shared to-do list with sign-in.
Add Convex as the backend of this existing React project.
How should I index and paginate a messages table that grows to millions of rows?

description: Convex gives agents the Convex runbook for starting a new app or adding Convex to an existing project, plus guidance on indexes, pagination, and scaling. These guidance tools need no account and no key.
